status: Planning data extracted from the locked shooting script. No final voices have been recorded and nothing has been rendered. Every line not marked original=true or creator_approved is proposed dialogue; the additions and the rating pass are in the script by default and are not canon until Daxtyn accepts them (SERIES.md section 5). creator_approved lines use wording Daxtyn approved on 2026-10-18; X17-11 sits in the proposed addition X17, so only its wording is approved.
rules: Only text following a named speaker or NARRATOR is spoken. NOTE lines, PICTURE/SOUND lines, markers, WAS text and PENDING notes are never spoken or subtitled.
'text' holds only the spoken words of the shooting text (the NOW side of a CHANGED block): no quotes, no bracketed notes, no [ORIGINAL] marker.

original=true marks Daxtyn's [ORIGINAL] lines: perform and subtitle them byte-exact. The handoff had four; the fourth, L048, now uses the wording he approved on 2026-10-18 (was_original=true, was_text keeps his old line).

creator_approved=2026-10-18 marks the five lines whose wording Daxtyn chose on that date (L048, L053, L054, L109, X17-11; they named a species he scrapped): perform and subtitle them byte-exact; was_text is the old wording, which is not recorded.
pending=P# would mark a line kept as written while Daxtyn decides its wording; none is open since 2026-10-18.
An em dash at the end of 'text' means the line is cut off (interrupted=true); a leading em dash means it picks up a cut-off line ('continues').
Subtitles come from the final recorded dialogue; re-run this script if the script changes.

fields.id: L001..L198 = the handoff's lines (same ids as ../dialogue.json); X#-NN = line NN of proposed addition X#; R#-NN = line NN of proposed rating-pass block R#
fields.scene: the handoff scene the line plays in (PROLOGUE, 1A..3D); additions are counted in the scene they sit in
fields.part: the addition's own scene heading, when it has one
fields.addition / rating_pass: the block the line is in (a rating-pass block can sit inside an addition)
fields.changed_by / was_text: the CHANGED block that rewords this line and the wording it replaced (kept in screenplay-final.md)
fields.creator_approved / was_original: the date Daxtyn approved this wording, and whether the old wording was one of his [ORIGINAL] lines (see rules)
fields.rating_content: what the line carries for the mature rating (SERIES.md section 8)
fields.delivery: bracketed performance note (if any) and the context; context_source says whether it was hand-checked or taken automatically from the stage direction before the line
fields.est_seconds / timing_rule: estimated natural speaking time, same model as ../dialogue.json
fields.source_line: 1-based line of the quoted text in final/screenplay-final.md

timing_model.summary: Same model as ../dialogue.json (extract_dialogue.py): words / 2.6 per s conversational; / 2.1 for narrator and whispered, quiet, low or in-pain lines; +0.25 s (narrator 0.4 s) per internal sentence break; one-word commands 0.6-1.0 s; floor 0.6 s; rounded to 0.1 s.
timing_model.sung_lines: R13-01 is sung low: the speech model gives a floor; the shot list adds the extra sung time as picture time.
